title: Career Memory T-004A/B Grounded Claim Pipeline Synthetic Dataset Schema (v0.4.0-owner-review-candidate)
description: Structural schema for the v0.4.0-owner-review-candidate dataset package pending human owner review in T-004B (ADR-018: AI cannot record human approval). Separates Stage 2A FactCandidateExtractor vs Stage 2B FactSupportValidator vs CanonicalFact promotion, Stage 3A ClaimGenerator vs Stage 3B ClaimAtomizer vs Stage 3C ClaimSupportValidator with distinct role execution runs, official domain values (Fact types PROBLEM|ACTION|TECHNOLOGY|RESULT|ROLE|METRIC; Atom statuses SUPPORTED|USER_CONFIRMED|UNSUPPORTED|STALE) from TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY labels, and covers synthetic cases for REF-01..REF-08 and CLAIM-05/06/08 while explicitly distinguishing synthetic case preparation from unexecuted product runtime/E2E verification.
